reason: No mother in my Telegram group or at the kindergarten has mentioned Kiddo, so I won't pay for it. At most I'd put the free version on my phone in place of some cartoons and see if my child actually learns anything.
objection: It's still more time on the phone. I don't want my child glued to the screen, and I can't tell if this really teaches letters or is just cartoons with a different name.
would_change_my_mind: Several moms in my Telegram group or the kindergarten teacher saying their kids learned Uzbek letters with it, and that the lessons stay short.
